decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The LB of Hounslow as the LPA hereby certify that on 16/8/2004 the  proposed demolition of existing garage and construction of new detached garage, incorporating a  store room and workshop to rear of dwellinghouse  measuring a length of 9.1m by 3.6m high by 5.5m wide, (at its widest point),  would  have been lawful within the meaning of Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, (as amended), for the following reason: 
The proposed development would  fall within Class E, Part 1, Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order, 1995. 

INFORMATIVE 1 : The detached single storey outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No.1 Amhurst Gardens and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
INFORMATIVE 2 : The applicant is reminded that the works hereby approved shall be carried out within the curtillage of the property boundary.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed demolition of existing garage and construction of new detached garage, incorporating store room and workshop to rear of dwellinghouse
